accounts_tax_percentage_check.name: accounts_tax_percentage_check
accounts_tax_percentage_check.value: "accounts"."default_tax_percentage_bps" IS NULL OR (typeof("accounts"."default_tax_percentage_bps") = 'integer' AND "accounts"."default_tax_percentage_bps" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND "accounts"."type" IS 5)

accounts_tax_treatment_check.name: accounts_tax_treatment_check
accounts_tax_treatment_check.value: "accounts"."default_tax_treatment" IS NULL OR ("accounts"."type" IS 5 AND "accounts"."default_tax_treatment" IN ('ordinary_deductible', 'partial', 'non_deductible', 'capital_expenditure', 'unclassified', 'requires_review'))

depreciation_profile_amounts.name: depreciation_profile_amounts
depreciation_profile_amounts.value: typeof("base_nbv_minor") = 'integer' AND "base_nbv_minor" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991 AND typeof("residual_minor") = 'integer' AND "residual_minor" BETWEEN 0 AND "base_nbv_minor" AND typeof("months") = 'integer' AND "months" BETWEEN 1 AND 1200

fixed_assets_business_check.name: fixed_assets_business_check
fixed_assets_business_check.value: "fixed_assets"."business_use_bps" IS NULL OR (typeof("fixed_assets"."business_use_bps") = 'integer' AND "fixed_assets"."business_use_bps" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000)

fixed_assets_source_check.name: fixed_assets_source_check
fixed_assets_source_check.value: ("fixed_assets"."source_record_id" IS NOT NULL AND "fixed_assets"."source_movement_id" IS NOT NULL AND "fixed_assets"."source_sort_order" IS NOT NULL AND "fixed_assets"."source_snapshot" IS NOT NULL AND "fixed_assets"."opening_as_at" IS NULL AND "fixed_assets"."brought_forward_dep_minor" = 0 AND "fixed_assets"."opening_record_id" IS NULL) OR ("fixed_assets"."source_record_id" IS NULL AND "fixed_assets"."source_movement_id" IS NULL AND "fixed_assets"."source_sort_order" IS NULL AND "fixed_assets"."source_snapshot" IS NULL AND "fixed_assets"."opening_as_at" IS NOT NULL)

fixed_assets_residual_check.name: fixed_assets_residual_check
fixed_assets_residual_check.value: "fixed_assets"."residual_minor" IS NULL OR (typeof("fixed_assets"."residual_minor") = 'integer' AND "fixed_assets"."residual_minor" BETWEEN 0 AND "fixed_assets"."cost_minor")

movements_tax_json_check.name: movements_tax_json_check
movements_tax_json_check.value: "ledger_movements"."tax_classification" IS NULL OR CASE WHEN json_valid("ledger_movements"."tax_classification") THEN coalesce(json_type("ledger_movements"."tax_classification", '$.percentageBps') IN ('null', 'integer') AND (json_extract("ledger_movements"."tax_classification", '$.percentageBps') IS NULL OR json_extract("ledger_movements"."tax_classification", '$.percentageBps') BETWEEN 0 AND 10000) AND json_extract("ledger_movements"."tax_classification", '$.source') IN ('account_default', 'override', 'unreviewed') AND json_extract("ledger_movements"."tax_classification", '$.treatment') IN ('ordinary_deductible', 'partial', 'non_deductible', 'capital_expenditure', 'unclassified', 'requires_review'), 0) ELSE 0 END

tax_capital_json.name: tax_capital_json
tax_capital_json.value: CASE WHEN json_valid("evidence") THEN coalesce(json_extract("evidence", '$.calculationVersion') = 2 AND json_type("evidence", '$.currency') = 'text' AND length(json_extract("evidence", '$.currency')) = 3 AND json_type("evidence", '$.rows') = 'array' AND json_type("evidence", '$.assets') = 'array' AND json_type("evidence", '$.utilisation') = 'array', 0) ELSE 0 END

tax_adjustment_amount.name: tax_adjustment_amount
tax_adjustment_amount.value: typeof("amount_minor") = 'integer' AND "amount_minor" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991 AND typeof("balance_minor") = 'integer' AND "balance_minor" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991

tax_adjustment_values.name: tax_adjustment_values
tax_adjustment_values.value: coalesce("kind" = 'source' OR ("kind" = 'other' AND "amount_minor" > 0 AND "balance_minor" = 0 AND "origin_ya" IS NULL) OR ("kind" = 'loss_brought_forward' AND "direction" = 'decrease' AND typeof("origin_ya") = 'integer' AND "origin_ya" BETWEEN 2000 AND 9999 AND "amount_minor" <= "balance_minor"), 0)

tax_adjustment_source.name: tax_adjustment_source
tax_adjustment_source.value: coalesce(("kind" = 'source' AND typeof("source_movement_id") = 'integer' AND "source_movement_id" > 0 AND typeof("percentage_bps") = 'integer' AND "balance_minor" = 0 AND "origin_ya" IS NULL AND (("treatment" = 'ordinary_deductible' AND "percentage_bps" = 10000) OR ("treatment" = 'partial' AND "percentage_bps" BETWEEN 1 AND 9999) OR ("treatment" IN ('non_deductible', 'capital_expenditure') AND "percentage_bps" = 0))) OR ("kind" <> 'source' AND "source_movement_id" IS NULL AND "percentage_bps" IS NULL AND "treatment" IS NULL), 0)

tax_revision_lock.name: tax_revision_lock
tax_revision_lock.value: ("status" = 'draft' AND "reviewed_at" IS NULL AND "finalised_at" IS NULL) OR ("status" = 'reviewed' AND "reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "finalised_at" IS NULL) OR ("status" = 'finalised' AND "reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "finalised_at" IS NOT NULL)
